question: GQ-006
question_asked: Is a second independent copy of the vault achievable from this machine?
answer: No. Every candidate is either the same physical device or unreachable.

candidates_tested.verdict: SAME DEVICE. Backed by /dev/disk5s2 — identical to the vault. The matching 3.8Ti free figure was the tell; df alone would have made these look like independent storage.
THE INTERNAL DRIVE. /dev/disk3s5 is Macintosh HD - Data, the same disk root runs on. Copying here protects against nothing and consumes the 18Gi I have been trying to preserve.
ALL OFFLINE. Six peers, every one offline — same dead link as the mailbox.

conclusion: The single-volume risk is real and NOT fixable from here. It needs hardware Shaan controls: a second external disk, or a reachable remote with 45 GB. Recording the measurement rather than inventing a copy that would live on the drive it is meant to protect against.
what_would_be_worse: Copying the vault to /Volumes/SISO-STORAGE-VAULT.ssd-copy-20260803 would LOOK like redundancy in any directory listing while being a second copy on the failing-together device — and it would consume 45 GB of an 18Gi budget, which it cannot even fit.
